name: story_note_02_title
Xiaoman: Dear shopkeeper senpai,

name: story_note_02_body
Xiaoman:
The little tavern is finally open! ٩(ˊᗜˋ*)و

Before opening, I peeled the last bit of protective film off the glass door. The blue sign across the street reflects in it. It turned out rather pretty.

Then the first person to walk past asked, ‘Are you still renovating?’

…I'd forgotten to take down the ‘Under renovation’ sign. I checked the menu over and over, and somehow missed the most obvious thing. Honestly…

This is the tape I played when I opened. I'd like you to hear it too. (´,,•ω•,,)♡

name: story_note_02_signature
Xiaoman: — Xiaoman

name: story_note_02_name
Xiaoman: A note from Xiaoman

name: xm_03_01
Xiaoman: Good evening, senpai. Here I am again.

name: xm_03_02

name: xm_03_shop
Xiaoman: I'd like to buy some food today. I've brought {0} credits.

name: story_note_03_title
Xiaoman: Dear shopkeeper senpai,

name: story_note_03_body
Xiaoman:
After asking you to help yesterday, I realized you have your own shop to run during the day.

Would working here in the evenings leave you too tired?

But when the dock shifts change, so many customers arrive at once. Sometimes I really can't manage them all on my own.

Please don't feel you have to. You're always welcome to just come for a drink, and if you do help, I'll make sure you're properly paid!

Here's this week's tape.

name: story_note_03_signature
Xiaoman: — Xiaoman

name: story_note_03_name
Xiaoman: A note from Xiaoman

name: xm_04_01
Xiaoman: Good evening. That little place I mentioned is finally open.

name: xm_04_02
Xiaoman: It's actually a little bar, down in the shopping passage below.

name: xm_04_shop
Xiaoman: I'd like to stock up on drinking water today.

name: xm_04_cocktail
Xiaoman: Oh, I brought a few cocktails from my bar. Would you buy things like these?

name: story_note_04_title
Xiaoman: Dear shopkeeper,

name: story_note_04_body
Xiaoman:
When it was time to close on my little bar's first night, most of the customers were still there. I ended up wiping the clean glasses all over again while I waited for them to leave.

The glass door clearly says we close at two in the morning. By the time I finally turned out the lights, it was nearly dawn.

Your shop always seems pretty quiet. Don't get too jealous~

This is what I played when I opened that night. It's yours.

It's lovely to meet someone else on this space station who listens to tapes.

name: story_note_04_signature
Xiaoman: — Xiaoman

name: story_note_04_name
Xiaoman: A note from Xiaoman

name: xm_05_01
Xiaoman: Good evening. A customer called me 'the owner' yesterday.

name: xm_05_02
Xiaoman: It took me a moment to realise she meant me. Even though it is my own place.

name: xm_05_shop
Xiaoman: I'd like a few everyday supplies today.

name: story_note_05_title
Xiaoman: Dear shopkeeper,

name: story_note_05_body
Xiaoman:
Thank you for yesterday.

A friend back home asked how the new place was going. I spent ages choosing a photo and finally sent one of the bar just after I'd switched on the lights.

She said, 'It looks wonderful.'

It's my own place, but hearing someone say that somehow made me more nervous.

Please come by more often. I've put up lots of new decorations.

I'd love a few pointers from someone with more experience.

name: story_note_05_signature
Xiaoman: — Xiaoman

name: story_note_05_name
Xiaoman: A note from Xiaoman

name: xm_06_01
Xiaoman: Good evening. A customer told me the other day that my cocktails were a little sweet.

name: xm_06_02
Xiaoman: But I thought they were just right... Am I the only one?

name: xm_06_shop
Xiaoman: I've come for some drinking water today.

name: story_note_06_title
Xiaoman: Dear shopkeeper,

name: story_note_06_body
Xiaoman:
A wealthy customer from the upper district said my cocktails were too sweet last night.

Today I kept adjusting the drink they said was too sweet.

A little less sugar, a sip. Then I put it back.

All they really said was 'a little sweet,' not that it tasted bad. Why have I been thinking about it for two days?

I'm leaving the menu alone today.

I'd like to know what you think.

name: story_note_06_signature
Xiaoman: — Xiaoman

name: story_note_06_name
Xiaoman: A note from Xiaoman

name: xm_07_01
Xiaoman: Good evening. My friends sent me a photo of their get-together yesterday.

name: xm_07_02
Xiaoman: They left an empty seat for me and even drew me into it. It doesn't look like me at all.

name: xm_07_shop
Xiaoman: I'd like some food today.

name: story_note_07_title
Xiaoman: Dear shopkeeper,

name: story_note_07_body
Xiaoman:
About that group photo...

I spent ages looking at an enlarged version.

The girl sitting next to me has cut her hair short. We used to talk about going for a haircut together, but we never got around to it.

She asked how things were going here. I wanted to send her a photo of myself, but when I looked through my pictures, all the recent ones were glasses and bottles.

I'll have to get someone to take a photo of me next time.

name: story_note_07_signature
Xiaoman: — Xiaoman

name: story_note_07_name
Xiaoman: A note from Xiaoman

name: xm_08_01
Xiaoman: Good evening. A few girls came in after their night shift yesterday. They were quite a lively bunch.

name: xm_08_02
Xiaoman: They kept telling jokes about work. I didn't understand a single one.

name: xm_08_shop
Xiaoman: I'm looking for some everyday supplies today.

name: story_note_08_title
Xiaoman: Dear shopkeeper,

name: story_note_08_body
Xiaoman:
Last night someone left a sparkly hair clip on the bar. I put it away, thinking they'd probably come back for it.

Sure enough, a girl came running back today. But the first thing she said was, 'Do you still have that drink with the cherry from yesterday?'

When I tried to give her the clip back, she told me to keep it as a deposit on her next drink.

...Can you really use something like that as a deposit?

name: story_note_08_signature
Xiaoman: — Xiaoman

name: story_note_08_name
Xiaoman: A note from Xiaoman

name: xm_09_01
Xiaoman: Good evening. The motion light outside my door came on several times yesterday.

name: xm_09_02
Xiaoman: I thought I had customers. It was just delivery carts passing by.

name: xm_09_shop
Xiaoman: I'd like some food today. Just a little will do.

name: story_note_09_title
Xiaoman: Dear shopkeeper,

name: story_note_09_body
Xiaoman:
I was taking stock today and found half a crate of lemons left. I used to worry about running out. Now I'll have to find a way to use them up.

Something seems to have changed in the shopping passage lately. There aren't as many people passing through.

I stood by the glass door for quite a while.

I haven't had this much time to relax in ages.

What do you usually do when you don't have any customers?

name: story_note_09_signature
Xiaoman: — Xiaoman

name: story_note_09_name
Xiaoman: A note from Xiaoman

name: xm_10_01
Xiaoman: Good evening. Someone who'd visited before came back yesterday.

name: xm_10_02
Xiaoman: She brought a friend along. Both of them even remembered my name.

name: xm_10_shop
Xiaoman: I'd like some drinking water.

name: story_note_10_title
Xiaoman: Dear shopkeeper,

name: story_note_10_body
Xiaoman:
About the customers who came yesterday.

They said they could have taken the direct lift back to their dorm, but they made a detour to see me.

One wanted something sweet. The other insisted on something sour. Once I set both glasses down, they started swapping them.

They laughed so loudly and kept telling terrible jokes.

I wish I could meet such friendly customers every day.

name: story_note_10_signature
Xiaoman: — Xiaoman

name: story_note_10_name
Xiaoman: A note from Xiaoman

name: xm_11_01
Xiaoman: Good evening. I've changed the opening hours on my door.

name: xm_11_02
Xiaoman: It used to say two in the morning. Now it says midnight. That gives me time to get home and eat something.

name: xm_11_shop
Xiaoman: I'd like some everyday supplies today.

name: story_note_11_title
Xiaoman: Dear shopkeeper,

name: story_note_11_body
Xiaoman:
I closed up early yesterday, just in time for a call from my mum.

She sent me a photo of the cherry tree at home in full bloom.

Do you know cherry blossoms?

Tonight I'm going to try a new range of cherry blossom drinks.

Please come and try them.

name: story_note_11_signature
Xiaoman: — Xiaoman

name: story_note_11_name
Xiaoman: A note from Xiaoman

name: xm_12_01
Xiaoman: Good evening. I've been rewriting the drinks menu.

name: xm_12_02
Xiaoman: The old one was crammed full. There's still plenty of blank space on the new one.

name: xm_12_shop
Xiaoman: I'd like some food today.

name: story_note_12_title
Xiaoman: Dear shopkeeper,

name: story_note_12_body
Xiaoman:
Today I folded up the old drinks menu and tucked it into the account book.

I wrote the first page just after I arrived, when I didn't know anyone here.

Last night I poured myself a little drink and sat down by the glass door for a rest.

I waited a long time, but no customers came.

The billboard opposite happened to turn orange. With the blue light from the bar shining through, there seemed to be two colours in my glass.

I sat looking at it for a while. Then an idea for a new cocktail came to me.

Please come and try my new creation.

name: story_note_12_signature
Xiaoman: — Xiaoman

name: story_note_12_name
Xiaoman: A note from Xiaoman

name: xm_13_01
Xiaoman: Good evening. I've been looking for some sturdy boxes. I'm getting ready to move.

name: xm_13_02
Xiaoman: Glasses are much harder to pack than clothes. I wish I hadn't bought quite so many.

name: xm_13_shop
Xiaoman: I'd like some everyday supplies today.

name: story_note_13_title
Xiaoman: Dear shopkeeper,

name: story_note_13_body
Xiaoman:
The man from the repair shop next door came to help move a cabinet. He asked if I still wanted the blue light.

I told him he could have it. He said his daughter loved that colour.

It turned out he didn't mean just the light. He meant the whole frame, sign and all.

...He certainly knows what to ask for.

Still, that's fine. At least I won't have to find a box big enough for it.

Xiaoman: A note from Xiaoman

name: xm_14_01
Xiaoman: ...Good evening. I'm taking the ship tomorrow. I've decided to go home.

name: xm_14_02
Xiaoman: I've sent everything ahead. It's just me and a backpack now. A bit like when I first arrived.

name: xm_14_shop
Xiaoman: I'd like some water for the journey.

name: xm_14_accept
Xiaoman: Yes, thank you. Just right.

name: xm_14_bye
Xiaoman: Well... I'd better go.

name: story_note_14_title
Xiaoman: Dear shopkeeper,

name: story_note_14_body
Xiaoman:
I've returned the keys to the landlord. My lovely glasses have gone ahead on the cargo ship. All I have left is a backpack.

I told my mum I was coming home. She laughed and laughed on the other end of the call.

I made three cocktails with the ingredients I had left, and left them here with the tape.

Thank you for everything, my friend.

name: xm_tavern_w02_entry_03

name: xm_tavern_w02_chat_01
Xiaoman: Before opening, I secretly practiced saying ‘welcome’ a few times. Then someone actually came in, and I got even more nervous.

name: xm_tavern_w02_chat_02
Xiaoman: A customer told me yesterday that they liked the music. Hehe. I do put a lot of thought into choosing tapes.

name: xm_tavern_w02_chat_03
Xiaoman: Some people like their drinks sweeter, others prefer something sour… I suppose there's still work to do on the menu.

name: xm_tavern_w02_chat_04

name: xm_03_03
Xiaoman: Making drinks and looking after the customers on my own… Sometimes I can hardly keep up.

name: xm_03_04
Xiaoman: If you're free tonight, could you give me a hand? I'll pay you, of course! I can't just take up your time for nothing.

name: xm_03_accept
Xiaoman: Thank you. Just what I needed.

name: xm_03_bye
Xiaoman: I'd better go. If you're free tonight, you're always welcome to stop by.

name: xm_03_04_already_worked
Xiaoman: I remember all the help you've given me lately. When things quieten down, come over and listen to some music too.

name: story_note_03_b_title
Xiaoman: Dear shopkeeper senpai,

name: story_note_03_b_body
Xiaoman:
Thank you for all your work yesterday!

I'd thought having another pair of hands would give us a little breathing room.

Then the customers kept coming, one after another. We barely had time for a proper conversation.

But after closing, I turned around and found the whole counter neatly tidied up.

Usually, I'd still have so much to do on my own.

Hehe. I was tired, but it was rather lovely.

Here's this week's tape.

name: xm_tavern_w03_work_offer_02
Xiaoman: I'll make sure you're paid. This is a proper job, you know.

name: xm_tavern_w03_work_w02_callback
Xiaoman: I remember you handing out menus for me. This time, I really must pay you for your help.

name: xm_tavern_w03_work_start

name: xm_tavern_w03_work_done_01
Xiaoman: Phew… We've finally caught up. You were a huge help!

name: xm_tavern_w03_work_done_02
Xiaoman: Here's your pay. Thanks to you, those customers didn't have a wasted trip.

name: xm_w03_thanks_bye
Xiaoman: I'd better get back to the tavern. Don't wear yourself out either.
